verdict.line: You lose if she chains Q into Ki Burst while all three Broken Wings charges and Valor are both up; you win once she's burned those cooldowns and you can stack Acquired Taste for free.

brief.thesis: Riven's kit is built around burst-then-escape: Q (Broken Wings) gives her three dash charges into you, W (Ki Burst) stuns on arrival, and E (Valor) both closes distance and blocks your return damage. Tahm has no dash to match that mobility, so he can't force trades on his terms early — he has to wait for her cooldowns to actually be down. That's the whole reason OP.GG measures a Riven lane/solo-kill edge here even though the full-game win rate (51% over 104 games) ends up roughly even.

tell.watch: Riven's Q charges and E (Valor) timer

theirWindow.when: all 3 Q charges and W both ready
theirWindow.what: She can Q in, Ki Burst stun, Q again, and finish with the knockback Q — don't stand still to trade autos here, hold Thick Skin's shield (E) for the stun landing and back off if you're not already at 3 Acquired Taste stacks.

yourWindow.when: her Q (13s CD) or E (10-6s CD) just went down
yourWindow.what: Step in and freely land Tongue Lash (Q) and autos — each Q and auto builds An Acquired Taste, and once she's at 3 stacks your next Q stuns her instead of just slowing, which is the moment to commit Devour (R).

start.why: 66.2% of Tahm players into this lane start it. The passive block on her auto-attack-leaning Q-into-autos poke pattern matters more than raw stats, since she wants to whittle you with Runic Blade-charged autos between dashes.

boots.why: 68.6% pick rate and the higher measured win rate (49.4% vs 43.5% for Mercury's Treads). Riven's damage is almost entirely physical autos and Q hits, so flat auto mitigation outvalues magic resist here.

core.why: Scales your health, which directly scales An Acquired Taste's bonus damage — the stacking HP is also what lets you tank her all-in windows instead of dying to them.
Standard second item in the two measured build paths that hit 71-86% win rate; keeps your stat growth on pace without giving up the Heartsteel stacking plan.
The Heartsteel into Dusk and Dawn into Riftmaker path measured 85.7% win rate (small sample, but the highest of the three recorded paths) — the omnivamp lets you win extended E-shielded trades.

situational.when: she's leaning on lifesteal or healing to win extended trades
she's building crit or attack speed around her empowered autos
her early auto-reliant poke is outpacing your sustain before level 6

runes.keystoneWhy: You can't out-dash her, so you win this lane by winning prolonged auto exchanges instead of burst exchanges — Grasp's periodic bonus health and heal rewards exactly that, and the extra max health also scales your passive's bonus damage.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite is the top pick at 51.8% and the Ignite DOT is what actually closes out a Devour kill once she's trapped at 3 stacks, since her E (Valor) block can't stop damage-over-time. Flash + Teleport is the measured second option if you'd rather prioritize split-push and TP-ganks over securing early lane kills.

playing.title: Don't trade on her Q-W window
playing.detail: If all three Broken Wings charges and Ki Burst are both up, you're in her kill window, not yours — hold Thick Skin's shield for the stun and disengage rather than trading autos.

playing.title: Farm through levels 3-5 if behind
playing.detail: The data shows Riven has the solo-kill edge in this window. If you can't safely stack Acquired Taste, just take farm — OP.GG's own read on this matchup is to fall back on farming when her cooldowns are up.

playing.title: Punish her dead cooldowns
playing.detail: The moment her Q (13s CD) or E (10-9-8-7-6s CD) goes down from an engage or escape, step in and land Tongue Lash plus autos — this is your actual damage window, not a neutral one.

playing.title: Devour only at 3 stacks
playing.detail: Don't throw R (Devour) as a panic button — it's strongest once your Q has stunned her from 3 Acquired Taste stacks, since Devour then finishes a champion who can no longer Valor away.

playing.title: Track her ult cooldown resetting to 10s
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile's cooldown drops to 10 seconds once she's already used it once in a fight (120/90/60/60/10s by rank), so don't assume she's out of ult mid-fight just because she used it already.

playing.title: Save E for the stun, not the poke
playing.detail: Thick Skin's passive already banks damage from her autos automatically — pop the active shield specifically when Ki Burst lands so the stored damage covers her follow-up Q, not her opening poke.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, boots, starting items, runes, and summoner spells above are OP.GG's measured picks for Tahm Kench into Riven top on the current patch (104 head-to-head games); the win rates and pick rates are real recorded numbers. The cooldown windows, stack-and-stun sequencing, and trade timing are my own tactical reading of the ability kits, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Riven will close use (Q) and basic attacks to deal damage and retreat with (E) often. Use [Q] when her (Q) is on cooldown to attack her with basic attacks and swallow her with [W] to kill her. However, Riven will gain the upper hand if she uses (Q) to close in again so try to nuke her quickly. Otherwise, focus on farming lane.
